notes.title: Wands Alliances patch notes (client version 1.1.5 -> 1.1.6)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Changed matchmaking to where it now places a player in an open game right away if available, and if not, asks if you want to be placed in a game with bots instead (and doesn’t add you automatically)
[*] Added new challenges with six new corresponding borders and seven new titles
[*] Changed icon for Healing Nova to make it easier to distinguish from other spells
[*] Removed a few timers from the tutorial and increased the length of others to make them easier to complete
[*] Moved level rewards for challenges and added a pop up when levelling + what you unlocked for better readability
[*] Add friend UI improved
[/list]

notes.title: Release notes 1.1 -> 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Fixed crash when a player left a game while it had spells still active in the level
Fix for rare desync between players after halftime in Sabotage
Fixed bug where the wrong title would be displayed in the player inspector for players without titles
Fix for player becoming invisible after switching teams in post match

notes.title: Wands Alliances: Uprising is here!
notes.notes:
Coming to Steam for the first time in conjunction with the Uprising update, Wands Alliances is a competitive multiplayer shooter of intense magic duels and combat! Play in teams of 3v3 and master the tactical aspects of teleportation and spell customization to become the most powerful Wielder of them all.

We'll show off some gameplay with our devs during the first day. Don't hesitate to ask any questions here or on our Discord. See you on the battlefield! notes.title: Full reveal of Wands Alliances: Uprising
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first of what we hope will be many streaming sessions! This Wednesday you'll get the opportunity to chat with some of the devs at Cortopia Studios as well as our community manager Twinbeard, who will be hosting the stream [url=https://www.twitch.tv/beyondframesent]on Twitch[/url]. During the stream you'll get a full rundown of the contents in the upcoming Uprising update to Wands Alliances! There will also be a giveaway where we sprinkle some game codes to the viewers.

The stream begins Wednesday 12 noon PDT/3 PM EDT/9 PM CET and runs approximately 1,5 hours. Tune in to the stream (linked above) and say hi! 🙂
